newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cegetel finances suffice for three years - Messier.
newsitem.headline: Cegetel finances suffice for three years - Messier.

text.p: The chairman of Generale des Eaux, Jean-Marie Messier, said that the international partners of telecoms unit Cegetel were bringing in seven billion francs of equity which would cover the investments for the next three years.
Generale des Eaux counts British Telecom Plc, SBC Communications Inc and Mannesmann AG as partners.

"They are bringing to Cegetel something like seven billion francs in free equity, which basically means that ...(Cegetel) will be able to finance its investments for the next three years," Messier told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
